assets.name: 提示词
assets.description: Prompt assets. Full baseline categories apply; strengthened restricted entity, personal information, infrastructure, and prompt injection detection.

assets.name: 工作流
assets.description: Workflow assets. Full baseline categories apply; recursive scanning of prompts, node configs, tool parameters, embedded resources.

assets.name: 数据集
assets.description: Dataset assets. Full baseline categories apply; additional checks for data provenance, production logs, sessions, raw input, evaluation information.

assets.name: Skills
assets.description: Skill assets. Full baseline categories apply; scan skill instructions, referenced files, scripts, configs, resources.

assets.name: 交付指导书
assets.description: Delivery guide assets. Full baseline categories apply; cover document properties, annotations, hidden content, attachments.

assets.name: 场景化方案
assets.description: Scenario solution assets. Full baseline categories apply; strengthened detection of customer, bank, internal scenario, and security control details.

assets.name: 知识库/经验库
assets.description: Knowledge base / experience base assets. Full baseline categories apply. Manifest must verify transformation evidence; missing evidence produces Unverifiable compliance finding. Evidence field: knowledge_base_transformed.

compliance_rules.name: 知识库转换验证
compliance_rules.description: Knowledge base must be transformed via LLM. When knowledge_base_transformed evidence is missing or Unverifiable, produce an AssetCompliance finding. Never infer weights from missing evidence.

assets.name: 模型
assets.description: Model assets. Full baseline categories apply. Manifest/security metadata must verify base-model and fine-tune evidence; missing evidence produces Unverifiable compliance finding. Evidence field: model_finetuned.

compliance_rules.name: 模型微调验证
compliance_rules.description: Only fine-tuned models may be released. When model_finetuned evidence is missing or Unverifiable, produce an AssetCompliance finding. Never infer weights from missing evidence.

assets.name: 工程工具
assets.description: Engineering tool assets. Full baseline categories apply; scan source code, binary strings, configs, generated templates, prompts (AI Coding tools + prompts).

assets.name: 本体
assets.description: Ontology assets. Full baseline categories apply; scan terms, entities, relations, aliases, restricted entity mappings.

assets.name: 镜像文件 (Docker/OCI)
assets.description: Docker/OCI container image assets. Full baseline categories apply; scan config, environment variables, history commands, all file layers. Strengthened restricted entity detection. Use labels like RESTRICTED_ENTITY_ALPHA for repository fixtures.
